# AI Flowi Workflow documentation
> Guides for building and troubleshooting documented AI Flowi Workflow workflows.

- [AI Flowi Workflow documentation](https://aiflowi.com/docs/) — 2026-09-29: Learn AI Flowi Workflow through its concepts, verified tutorials, component guidance, and troubleshooting pages.
- [How do I start with AI Flowi Workflow?](https://aiflowi.com/docs/getting-started/) — 2026-09-29: Follow a practical path from workflow concepts to a first Playground test, then learn routing, webhooks, and AI-assisted study.
- [What is AI Flowi Workflow?](https://aiflowi.com/docs/getting-started/what-is-ai-flowi-workflow/) — 2026-09-29: Understand AI Flowi Workflow's visual editor, reusable components, typed connections, and the roles of triggers, logic, AI, and actions.
- [How do workflows and connections work?](https://aiflowi.com/docs/getting-started/workflow-basics/) — 2026-09-29: Learn how AI Flowi Workflow components use settings, typed inputs, and outputs, and what to check before running a connected flow.
- [How do I use an AI assistant to learn AI Flowi Workflow?](https://aiflowi.com/docs/getting-started/learn-with-ai/) — 2026-09-29: Give a web-capable AI assistant the documentation entry page, request a workflow map, and check suggested components, ports, and tests.
- [AI Flowi Workflow tutorials](https://aiflowi.com/docs/tutorials/) — 2026-09-29: Choose a verified AI Flowi Workflow tutorial for Playground chat, fixed-condition routing, model selection, or webhook data sent to Google Sheets.
- [How do I build my first workflow?](https://aiflowi.com/docs/tutorials/first-workflow/) — 2026-09-29: Connect Chat Input, an AI model, and Chat Output in the AI Flowi Workflow Playground, then send a message to check the result.
- [How do I route a workflow with If-Else?](https://aiflowi.com/docs/tutorials/if-else-routing/) — 2026-09-29: Connect Chat Input to If-Else, configure a fixed text condition, and test the True and False Message outputs in AI Flowi Workflow.
- [How do I route between language models?](https://aiflowi.com/docs/tutorials/llm-selector-routing/) — 2026-09-29: Set up LLM Selector with a judge model and candidate models, then inspect its Message output and routing decision in AI Flowi Workflow.
- [How do I send webhook data to Google Sheets?](https://aiflowi.com/docs/tutorials/webhook-to-google-sheets/) — 2026-09-29: Receive webhook JSON, convert it to a Message, structure fields with a model, and append the resulting JSON to Google Sheets.
- [Which documented integrations can I use?](https://aiflowi.com/docs/integrations/) — 2026-09-29: Find documented AI Flowi Workflow integration paths for Telegram and Google services, with setup, connection, and troubleshooting guides.
- [How does the Telegram integration work?](https://aiflowi.com/docs/integrations/telegram/) — 2026-09-29: Learn how AI Flowi Workflow registers a Telegram webhook, receives updates, and parses message fields for downstream workflow steps.
- [How do I set up a Telegram webhook?](https://aiflowi.com/docs/integrations/telegram-webhook-setup/) — 2026-09-29: Register a public HTTPS Webhook endpoint with Telegram using the Telegram Webhook Setup extension in AI Flowi Workflow.
- [How do I parse Telegram updates?](https://aiflowi.com/docs/integrations/telegram-update-parser/) — 2026-09-29: Connect Webhook JSON to Telegram Update Parser and use its documented chat, user, text, and command fields in a workflow.
- [How do I build a Telegram AI bot?](https://aiflowi.com/docs/integrations/telegram-ai-bot/) — 2026-09-29: Build a Telegram message workflow with Webhook, Telegram Update Parser, workflow logic, and an optional Bot API reply.
- [Why is my Telegram workflow failing?](https://aiflowi.com/docs/integrations/telegram-troubleshooting/) — 2026-09-29: Diagnose Telegram webhook registration, incoming update parsing, type mismatches, and missing Bot API replies in AI Flowi Workflow.
- [How do AI Flowi Workflow components work?](https://aiflowi.com/docs/components/) — 2026-09-29: Learn how components connect in AI Flowi Workflow, then use the catalog or custom component guide to choose the next step.
